about_the_game:
About This Game

Step into the decaying halls of Mortimer Manor, where every ticking second erodes your grip on reality. In Doomed Inheritance, you’ll navigate grand foyers, shadowed galleries, and winding catacombs—all while a relentless sanity meter displayed as a brain icon fractures under the strain.

  • Dynamic Sanity System: Watch your brain HUD icon crack and splinter as time slips away. When your mind falters, controls stutter and visuals distort, heightening the dread.

  • Environmental Puzzles: Align haunted portraits, light candle‐powered sigils, balance ancient scales, and decipher blood‐drip ciphers to unlock new wings of the estate.

  • Exploration & Secrets: Hunt for hidden alcoves, secret pantries, and forgotten journals that shed light on the Mortimer curse—and grant fleeting relief in the form of youth vials.

  • Atmospheric Presentation: Immerse yourself in hand‐crafted Gothic corridors, eerie soundscapes, and flickering candlelight that reveal—or conceal—the manor’s darkest secrets.

  • Early Access Content: Experience the opening chapters, from the grand staircase down to the relic‐filled catacombs. Future updates may expand the estate, introduce fresh puzzles, and deepen the narrative, guided by community feedback.

Are you prepared to inherit centuries of ambition—and pay the ultimate price? Your borrowed time begins now.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible card (Windows)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: N/A

short_description: Doomed Inheritance is a first-person psychological horror puzzle game set in a decaying Gothic manor where a brain-shaped sanity meter steadily drains. Explore eerie rooms, solve immersive environmental, light-and-shadow, and pattern puzzles, and collect vials to stave off creeping control drift.
